mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_histories ( business_id, customer_id, staff_id, reservation_id, visit_date, services, total_price, payment_method, details, before_image_url, after_image_url ) VALUES ( #{businessId}, #{customerId}, #{staffId}, #{reservationId}, #{visitDate}, #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentMethod}, #{details, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{beforeImageUrl}, #{afterImageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_histories WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY visit_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_histories SET staff_id = #{staffId}, visit_date = #{visitDate}, services = #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, total_price = #{totalPrice}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, details = #{details, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, before_image_url = #{beforeImageUrl}, after_image_url = #{afterImageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_histories WHERE id = #{id})
